proposed_widenings.name: on_miss_trigger (class feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Studied Attacks fires automatically whenever the fighter misses an attack roll — no player-initiated activation, no use-count resource, no rest reset cadence. The only existing class feature family is 'activation', which requires activationCost + resource + resetCadence. None of those fields exist for this feature. A new passive-trigger family (analogous to mastery's on_hit_trigger) is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you make an attack roll against a creature and miss, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants Advantage on attack rolls. modify_roll_advantage exists in v4 taxonomy and is already present in MasteryEffect, but ClassFeatureEffect only contains GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect. Threading this effect type into class features is needed for Studied Attacks (and similar class features).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn

notes: Studied Attacks is a passive, unlimited on-miss rider: fires automatically on every missed attack roll, consumes no resource, has no activation cost. The activation family cannot represent this without fabricating resource/resetCadence fields that do not exist in the rule. Both gaps are present; the family gap is the structural one. The on_miss_window atom already exists in v4 — the missing piece is a class feature family that can root to it rather than to an explicit activation.
